general.label: General
general.description: Choose the timezones used to display and import your trades.

trading.label: Trading
trading.description: Manage contract multipliers, breakeven rules, fees, and risk defaults.

currency.label: Currency conversion
currency.description: Set a reporting currency and saved exchange rates for combined performance.

marketData.label: Market data
marketData.description: Connect price history or upload candles for replay and trade analysis.

ai.label: AI
ai.description: Choose your AI provider and manage your model and API key.

data.label: Data & backups
data.description: Download your journal data for safekeeping or use in other tools.

language.title: Language
language.description: Changes the interface language only. Trading timezones, exchange rates and all journal data are independent of this setting.

dataExport.title: Export your data
dataExport.intro: Download your journal data, or export your trades as a CSV.
dataExport.jsonNote: The JSON file is a data export for use in other tools. It is not a directly restorable full backup — a complete local backup requires stopping the app and copying the data directory.

timezones.title: Timezones
timezones.displayHelp: Trade times, calendars, journal days, and analytics use this timezone.
timezones.importHelp: Used for timestamps without an offset in file imports and IBKR broker sync. You can override it for each file. Existing trades are not changed; correcting an IBKR account's timezone requires a separate account for recovery.

multipliers.title: Contract multipliers
multipliers.fieldHelp: Use the exact symbol shown on your imported trades, including the contract month when present.
multipliers.recalcNote: Saving multipliers recalculates existing trade P&L from fills and preserves annotations.
multipliers.invalidLine: Check line {line}: enter a unique symbol and a positive multiplier, such as ESU6=50.

defaults.title: Breakeven, fees and risk defaults
defaults.breakevenHelp: Closed trades within this net P&L range count as breakeven. Actual P&L is unchanged. Percentage mode uses entry price × total entry quantity × contract multiplier; configure multipliers for derivatives first.
defaults.feesHelp: Applied to new fills with a zero fee, including explicit zeroes. Nonzero imported fees and existing fills are kept. The first matching rule wins.
defaults.riskHelp: Distances from weighted entry, adjusted for long or short direction. Applied only when a new trade is first created. The first matching rule wins.

currency.title: Currency conversion
currency.intro: Combine accounts using your own saved exchange rates. Works entirely offline.
currency.enable: Convert dashboard and calendar to the reporting currency
currency.reportingHelp: Changing the reporting currency clears the draft rates. Enter new rates before saving.
currency.fixedNote: These are fixed baseline rates, not live market rates. Changing saved rates recalculates all dashboard and calendar history, including starting balances and drawdown. Original account records, trade details and reports keep their account currencies.
currency.saved: Conversion settings saved. Dashboard and calendar figures now use these settings.
currency.missingRate: Enter a rate for {currencies} before enabling conversion.

marketData.title: Market data
marketData.intro: Connect historical prices for estimated MAE/MFE and candle replay on closed trades. Vela renders the charts. No data source is enabled or selected by default. Choose a connection or upload your own candles. Market data connections are separate from broker sync and AI.
marketData.credentialsNote: Credentials are encrypted locally and used only by the server for market data. Saved secrets are never returned to the browser or included in journal exports.
marketData.envIncomplete: Complete all required fields in the server environment.
marketData.testPublic: Public endpoint reachable. No API key or paid data plan is required. Candle availability depends on the pair, date range and public API limits.
marketData.testVerified: Connection verified. Instrument coverage depends on your provider access.
marketData.savedMessage: Credentials saved. Test the connection to verify access.

providers.lseDescription: Historical candles. Stock and ETF prices are split adjusted; coverage depends on your plan.
providers.lseSymbolHint: Use the exact provider symbol, including the futures contract or currency pair.
providers.alpacaDescription: US stocks and crypto. Choose a stock or crypto feed; SIP requires appropriate data access. Stock prices are unadjusted.
providers.alpacaSymbolHint: Stocks: AAPL. Crypto: BTC/USD; choose the Crypto dataset.
providers.binanceDescription: Public Binance spot candles. No API key required. Availability depends on your region and the listed pair.
providers.binanceSymbolHint: Spot pairs use BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT. USDT is not USD; account and quote currencies must match for estimates.
providers.coinbaseDescription: Public Coinbase Exchange spot candles. No API key required; intervals without trades may have no candle.
providers.coinbaseSymbolHint: Use a Coinbase Exchange product such as BTC-USD or ETH-USD.
providers.oandaDescription: Forex and CFD candles from your v20 account. Midpoint prices, UTC-aligned bars and tick-count volume; no spread or FX conversion is included.
providers.oandaSymbolHint: Use an OANDA instrument such as EUR_USD. Set the contract multiplier in Settings to match the units in your fills.
providers.csvDescription: Local OHLCV candle files. Upload market prices separately from your trade executions.
providers.csvSymbolHint: Use the exact symbol and resolution recorded for the uploaded file. Select a dataset when files overlap.

csv.title: Market data CSV
csv.intro: Upload one instrument and candle resolution per file, up to 5 MB / 50,000 rows. Required columns: time, open, high, low, close. Volume is optional. Time is the bar open: ISO-8601 with timezone, Unix seconds or milliseconds. Daily bars must start at 00:00 UTC. These are market candles, separate from trade execution imports.
csv.fileTooLarge: Use a CSV smaller than 5 MB.
csv.symbolPlaceholder: Exact symbol used in your file
csv.previewSummary: {count, plural, one {# candle} other {# candles}} · {from} to {to}
csv.imported: Market candles imported. Choose Market data CSV on a trade or in Reports.
csv.removed: Dataset and its saved estimates removed.

ai.title: AI (bring your own key)
ai.intro: Use Anthropic or OpenAI for recaps, trade critiques, and “ask your journal”. Your key is encrypted at rest. AI requests go from your server directly to the provider you select.
ai.modelHelp: Use a text model available to your provider account. Each provider keeps its own model and key.
ai.envKeyNote: Using {variable} from the server environment. Change or remove that variable on the server to update the key.
ai.savedKeyNote: Leave blank to keep your saved key, or enter a replacement.
ai.addKeyNote: Add your API key, then save to use this provider.
